p: Astronaut Pikachu, a new costumed Pokémon, appears in raids.
Free Timed Research runs all week.
3x catch XP, 2x catch Candy and boosted Zorua spawns.
Evolve Zorua during the event or up to 4 hours after to get Zoroark with the exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch.
Lure and Special Trade bonuses run until 9 pm.
Wild Zorua can carry a special background.

highlights.label: DEBUT · Brambleghast (evolve Bramblin: 50 candy + 20 km as buddy; Leek Duck, not in the official post)
WILD ENCOUNTERS · Ponyta, Doduo, Electrike, Blitzle + more

p: Bramblin debuts.
Brambleghast can also be had by evolving Bramblin. Leek Duck lists 50 Bramblin Candy and 20 km walked as your buddy; the official post does not mention it, and Pokémon GO Hub said it was unconfirmed.
Mega Manectric gets a Super Max Level and the Charged Attack Discharge+.
Higher chance of Shiny Electrike.
Boosted Shiny Hisuian Growlithe from Incense starts Oct 16 at 10 am.
bonuses: Incense: boosted shiny Hisuian Growlithe from Oct 16

p: Sandile hatches more often from 2 km Eggs, with boosted shiny odds.
Double Hatch Candy and half Egg Hatch Distance.
Only at Target, Best Buy and GameStop: open Pokémon GO in store for Timed Research with Gastly, Haunter and Gengar encounters.
Mega Gengar appears more often in Mega Raids at those stores, and its Gengar can be Shiny.
Start the research by Oct 20, 10 pm local time. Claim rewards before Nov 20.
Minior debuts in Meteor Form.
Extra Stardust for catches, best from 5 pm to 9 pm daily.
Runs Oct 19 at 5 pm to Oct 24 at 11:59 pm local time.
Max Battle Day for the Dynamax Lake Spirits.
Power Spots refresh more often and the Max Particle limit rises.
Costumed Pikachu (hat and capelet), Zubat (top hat) and Sinistea (bow) arrive, plus Piplup and Drifblim in Halloween Mischief costumes in the wild. All can be shiny.
Chandelure is the Super Mega Raid boss, and Mega Chandelure debuts.
Chandelure caught from Super Mega Raids has Mega Level 1 unlocked. Increased chance of Shiny Chandelure.
Up to 14 Raid Passes a day from Gym Photo Discs. Remote Raid limit is 20 from Fri Oct 30, 5 pm to Sat Oct 31, 8 pm (Pacific time).
The ticket (US$4.99 tier) adds extra bonuses; the official post says it will be in the web store soon.
GO Pass progression runs Oct 27, 10 am to Nov 5, 8 pm local time. Rank 10 unlocks 2x Candy (3x with GO Pass Deluxe); Rank 20 unlocks 2x Stardust (3x with Deluxe).
Shiny Greavard debuts (wild, GO Pass and Field Research), and Houndstone evolves from it with 50 Candy. More Rowlet, Greavard and Litwick in the wild; Gengar is rare.
Mega Sableye can reach Super Max Level and gains Night Shade+ while Mega Evolved.
Ticketed, in Sendai, Japan. You pick one of the three days.
Gigantamax Duraludon, Dynamax Dialga and Palkia, and Hisuian Sliggoo and Goodra debut.
Location backgrounds for ticket holders.
bonuses: Up to 10 free Raid Passes a day

p: Crowned Sword Zacian and Crowned Shield Zamazenta in five-star raids, with Raid Hour at 6 pm on Nov 9 (Zacian) and Nov 10 (Zamazenta).
Dynamax Regidrago debuts in five-star Max Battles on Nov 12; Registeel Nov 11, Latias and Latios Nov 13. Dynamax Meltan debuts in GO Pass.
Remote Raid limit 30 (Nov 9 to 13). Shiny Gimmighoul from the Coin Bag and shiny Meltan from the Mystery Box until Nov 15, 6 pm. Daily Discoveries pause Nov 9 to 15.
Gigantamax Duraludon debuts in six-star Max Battles. Dynamax Dialga on Saturday, Dynamax Palkia on Sunday.
Five-star raids: Zekrom and White Kyurem on Saturday, Reshiram and Black Kyurem on Sunday.
Optional ticket (A$ price not confirmed). Daily Discoveries pause Nov 9 to 15.
